# Hafiz Air Conditioning — Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

> Riyadh's most trusted AC repair, washing machine repair, refrigerator service and 24/7 emergency home appliance company. Founded 2006. Serving all Riyadh districts.

## About

Hafiz Air Conditioning is a Saudi-owned and operated home appliance service company based in Al Quds District, Riyadh. With 18+ years of experience and 3,500+ satisfied customers, we are the leading AC and appliance repair provider in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +966 59 113 6834
- **Address:** Muhammad Ibn Faisal Ibn Turki, Al Quds, Riyadh 13214, Saudi Arabia
- **Google Rating:** 4.9 stars (76+ reviews)
- **Hours:** Sunday–Thursday 8am–10pm | Emergency 24/7

## Services

- **AC Repair & Cleaning Riyadh** — split AC, central AC, cassette, window units. All brands. Same-day service.
- **Washing Machine Repair Riyadh** — front-load, top-load, all brands. No-fix no-fee guarantee.
- **Refrigerator Repair Riyadh** — compressor, gas recharge, thermostat, PCB. Emergency 2-hour response.
- **Microwave Oven Repair Riyadh** — all brands, HV-safe certified technicians.
- **Home Appliance Maintenance Plans** — annual contracts for residential and commercial.
- **24/7 Emergency Service Riyadh** — guaranteed technician arrival within 2 hours, any day.
